# The Switch 2's 9 GB pool; the heap check (upstream, 2026-11-14) found a 4.94 GB heap, which mem_reserve holds. The same values ran on an iPhone 18 Pro Max from the provisional profile (2026-11-27: memory pool 9.00 GB, guest files 9.88 GB, heap 4.94 GB, alias region mapped up to +2.27 GB of 4.38 GB)
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource
# MapPhysicalMemory refused past the 9 GB pool, as on Horizon: upstream's host turns it on for every Switch 2 game (NXNative a694f1799, not ported) and played this game so; NX 18's default is off

# The game sets conditional rendering (SetRenderEnableConditional): upstream's host evaluates it for every game and played this one so; NX 18 evaluates it only with this key (without it, a red line and everything drawn)
# No registered shader tables: each build's own split makes them (scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py split_tables, a shader-only derived profile). The merged 1.2.1 NUP splits to 37,306 keys,
# the two-program layout upstream registered to 30,630, so no one set of tables matches every legally owned and acquired copy and the strict comparison would stop one of them
